title.zh: 资讯通信媒体发展局（受管制人士）公告 2026
title.en: Info-communications Media Development Authority (Regulated Persons) Notification 2026

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Notification is the Info‑communications Media Development Authority (Regulated Persons) Notification 2026 and comes into operation on 2 October 2026.
2. The persons specified in the Schedule are each a regulated person for the purposes of the definition of “regulated person” in section 59(1) of the Act.
3. Revoke the Media Development Authority of Singapore (Regulated Persons) Notification 2003 (G.N. No. S 176/2003).
